page.layout: One printed page: title page, centred. Large title block at top, author line, dedication in italic, a woodcut of a griffin-like beast with a plinth, then the date below the image. Handwritten number "2" at top right is not printed and is left out.

l.i: cam, in eorum gratiam qui eius artis
mysteriis aut iam initiati, aut prope-

main_text.l: M. D. X C I X.

page.notes: The woodcut shows a winged, clawed beast standing on a ground plinth with plants at either side; no text inside it. The first line's "I" is a large initial letter. The line "IESVITI-" is hyphenated at the line end as printed and the word continues as "cam" on the next line. The printed date reads MDXCIX (shown in the scan as M. D. X C I X.). Some letters in the title are damaged or faint but are read as above.
